cues.zh: [笑声] [吉他弹奏]
cues.en: [laughs] [guitar playing]

cues.zh: 最后给你们讲个小故事，关于一段音乐
cues.en: I'm gonna leave you with this little story, it's about this piece of music

cues.zh: 这是一段非常流行的音乐，我相信你们都知道，我现在把旋律唱出来
cues.en: It's a very popular piece of music, I'm sure you all know it but I'll sing the melody right now

cues.zh: [唱] 哒，哒哒哒，哒哒哒，哒哒哒哒哒哒哒
cues.en: [singing] Ba, da da da, da da da, da da da da da da da

cues.zh: 没错，帕赫贝尔的D大调卡农
cues.en: Yeah, Pachelbel's Canon in D

cues.zh: 它在古典音乐界可是大热之作，我知道这个是因为我是个极客
cues.en: It's a big hit in the classical world and I know this because I'm a geek

cues.zh: 我知道你们在想什么：“Rob，你不可能是个极客，你会弹吉他，你太酷了！”
cues.en: I know what you're thinking: "Rob, you can't be a geek, you play guitar, you're so cool!"

cues.zh: 好吧，你们没这么想，但我这么想了
cues.en: O.K., you weren't thinking that, but I was

cues.zh: 其实我并非一直都这么酷，因为我并非一直都弹吉他。我最初学的是大提琴。
cues.en: Well, I haven't always been this cool because I haven't always played guitar. I started out on the cello.

cues.zh: 是啊……大提琴是件美妙绝伦的乐器。成年人拉大提琴很酷。
cues.en: Yeah... the cello is a wonderful, beautiful instrument. it's cool to be an adult that plays the cello.

cues.zh: 可小时候拉大提琴简直糟透了。
cues.en: Being a kid that played the cello sucked.

cues.zh: 拿着比自己还大的乐器，根本酷不起来。
cues.en: 'Cause there's no way to be cool when your instrument is larger than you

cues.zh: 背着大提琴走路上学，就像塞伦盖蒂草原上受伤的瞪羚。
cues.en: When you walk to school with a cello you're like a wounded gazelle on the Serengeti, man.

cues.zh: 恶霸们隔着老远就能闻到你来了。
cues.en: The bullies just smell you coming from a mile away

cues.zh: “哦，我不知道那玩意儿是啥，但我知道我要把它弄坏。”
cues.en: "Ooh, I don't know what that think is but I know I'm gonna break it."

cues.zh: 但我忍受了所有这些欺负，因为我热爱我们演奏的音乐。
cues.en: But I put up with all of the abuse because I loved the music that we played.

cues.zh: 我热爱我们在管弦乐队演奏的一切……
cues.en: I loved everything we played in orchestra...

cues.zh: 除了这个。
cues.en: except this.

cues.zh: 我特别讨厌帕赫贝尔的D大调卡农。
cues.en: I hate Pachelbel's Canon in D with a passion

cues.zh: 我这么讨厌它，是因为大提琴部分是有史以来最糟糕的大提琴部分。
cues.en: I hate it so much because the cello part is the worst cello part

cues.zh: 大提琴部分历史上最烂的。
cues.en: ever written in the history of cello parts

cues.zh: 就是8个四分音符，我们一遍又一遍地重复，它们是：
cues.en: It's 8 quarter notes that we repeated over and over again, they are as follows:

cues.zh: D
cues.en: D

cues.zh: A
cues.en: A

cues.zh: B
cues.en: B

cues.zh: 升F
cues.en: F Sharp

cues.zh: G
cues.en: G

cues.zh: D
cues.en: D

cues.zh: G
cues.en: G

cues.zh: A
cues.en: A

cues.zh: 我们就只能演奏这些。
cues.en: And that's all we got to play.

cues.zh: 我们把这8个音符重复了54遍。
cues.en: We repeated those 8 notes 54 times.

cues.zh: 我数过了。
cues.en: I counted.

cues.zh: 因为我没别的事可做。
cues.en: Because I had nothing else to do.

cues.zh: 我会坐下来听小提琴奏出美妙的旋律
cues.en: I would sit back and listen to the violins get lovely melodies

cues.zh: 中提琴奏出美妙的旋律
cues.en: The violas would get lovely melodies

cues.zh: 第二小提琴奏出美妙的旋律
cues.en: The second violins would get lovely melodies

cues.zh: 这本来就不该发生
cues.en: which should just not happen

cues.zh: 而大提琴，我们却只能拉那8个糟糕透顶、烂到家的音符。
cues.en: And the cello, we got stuck with 8 crappy, lousy, stinking notes.

cues.zh: 我开始琢磨为什么。帕赫贝尔为什么要这样对我们？这么美的乐器。
cues.en: And I began to wonder why. Why would Pachelbel do that to us? Such a beautiful instrument.

cues.zh: 我的推测是他曾和一个大提琴手约会过
cues.en: And my theory was he once dated a cellist

cues.zh: 而她狠狠地甩了他
cues.en: and she dissed him really bad

cues.zh: 所以余生他都在写他能想到的最烂的大提琴声部
cues.en: So for the rest of his life he came up with the worst cello parts he could ever think of

cues.zh: 要不是我每天都听到它，也不至于这么难受，
cues.en: It wouldn't be so bad if I didn't hear him every day,

cues.zh: 我知道你在想什么，你在想“罗布，别再听古典音乐电台了。”
cues.en: I know what you're thinking, you're thinking "Rob, don't listen to classical radio anymore."

cues.zh: 我……这不重要。
cues.en: I... it doesn't matter.

cues.zh: 帕赫贝尔在跟着我。
cues.en: Pachelbel's following me.

cues.zh: 听起来有点偏执，但他也在跟着你。你每天都能听到他。
cues.en: It sounds paranoid but he's following you too. You hear him every day.

cues.zh: 我不知道，我去参加了我继侄子姻亲的八年级毕业典礼
cues.en: I don't know, I went to my step-nephew-in-law's 8th grade graduation

cues.zh: 他们的毕业歌是Vitamin C的一首歌。不，
cues.en: and their graduation song was a song by Vitamin C. No,

cues.zh: [唱Vitamin C的《Graduation (Friends Forever)》] 当我们继续前行……
cues.en: [singing "Graduation (Friends Forever)" by Vitamin C] As we go on...

cues.zh: 我们会记得……啦，哒哒哒，哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒
cues.en: we'll remember... La, da da da, da da da da da da da da da da

cues.zh: 所以开车回家的路上我放了些经典摇滚，Aerosmith的
cues.en: So on the drive home I turned on some classic rock, some Aerosmith

cues.zh: [唱Aerosmith的《Cryin'》] 曾经有一段时间
cues.en: [singing Aerosmith's "Cryin'"] There was a time

cues.zh: 当我心碎不已，啦，哒哒哒，哒哒哒哒哒哒
cues.en: when I was so broken hearted, La, da da da, da da da da da da

cues.zh: 到家后我想用点民谣音乐理清思绪。不……
cues.en: So I got home I thought I'd clear my mind with some folk music. No...

cues.zh: [唱Coven的《One Tin Soldier》] 孩子们听我的故事，它写于很久以前
cues.en: [singing "One Tin Soldier" by Coven] Listen children to my story, It was written long ago

cues.zh: 啊吧，哒哒哒，哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒
cues.en: A-ba, da da da, da da da da da da da da da da

cues.zh: 他们弹帕赫贝尔，就像所有人弹帕赫贝尔一样，纯粹是为了折磨我！
cues.en: They do Pachelbel just like everybody does Pachelbel just to torment me!

cues.zh: 我都不去塔可钟了，因为听起来太像了。
cues.en: I don't even go to Taco Bell anymore because it sounds too close.

cues.zh: 我特别讨厌帕赫贝尔，我甚至都不知道他的名字。
cues.en: I hate Pachelbel with a passion, I don't even know his first name.

cues.zh: 可能是约翰吧。他们都叫约翰！
cues.en: It's probably Johann. They're all named Johann!

cues.zh: 仔细想想，他才是最早的一曲成名。
cues.en: And when you think about it he's the original one hit wonder.

cues.zh: 他三百年前就火了一首，这成了我一辈子的负担。
cues.en: He had one hit 300 years ago it's my cross to bear my entire life.

cues.zh: 他们现在在哪？我就想知道，帕赫贝尔，你现在在哪？
cues.en: Where are they now? That's what I want to know, where are you now, Pachelbel?

cues.zh: VH1的《我爱1790年代》，在哪呢？
cues.en: VH1's "I love the 1790s, where is it?"

cues.zh: 他要是能离我喜欢的音乐远点就好了，但他不会。
cues.en: And if he would just stay away from music that I love it would be better, but he won't

cues.zh: 他真是不要脸。他会跟着我到天涯海角。
cues.en: He is shameless. He will follow me to the ends of the earth.

cues.zh: 我去HORDE音乐节的时候想，“不，他不可能跟到HORDE音乐节来吧”。
cues.en: I went to HORDE Festival thinking, "no, he couldn't possibly follow me to the HORDE Festival"

cues.zh: 但你知道谁在HORDE音乐节吗？Blues Traveler！
cues.en: But you know who was at the HORDE Festival? Blues Traveler!

cues.zh: 也就是说，帕赫贝尔也参加过HORDE音乐节！
cues.en: So that means that Pachelbel was also at the HORDE Festival!

cues.zh: [唱Blues Traveler的《The Hook》]吸进去，吸进去，吸进去，当你是Amber Lynn或Rin Tin Tin……
cues.en: [singing "The Hook" by Blues Traveler] Suck it in, suck it in, suck it in, when you're Amber Lynn or Rin Tin Tin...

cues.zh: 孤注一掷，然后你就进了哒哒哒哒，哒，哒哒哒，哒哒哒哒哒哒
cues.en: Make a desperate move and then you're in a-da da da da, da, da da da, da da da da da da

cues.zh: 所以我打算这辈子都听朋克摇滚。结果没戏。
cues.en: So I figure I'm gonna listen to punk rock for the rest of my life. No dice.

cues.zh: [唱Green Day的《Basket Case》]你有没有时间
cues.en: [Singing Green Day's "Basket Case"] Do you have the time

cues.zh: 来听我发牢骚？
cues.en: to listen to me whine?

cues.zh: 啊吧，哒哒哒，哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒，哒，哒哒哒，哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒
cues.en: A-ba, da da da, da da da da da da da da da da, da, da da da, da da da da da da da da da da

cues.zh: 你知道我真是越来越无聊了
cues.en: You know I'm getting really bored

cues.zh: 因为所有歌的和弦都一个鬼样
cues.en: 'Cause all songs have the same damn chords

cues.zh: 朋克音乐是个笑话
cues.en: Punk music is a joke

cues.zh: 其实不过是巴洛克
cues.en: it's really just Baroque

cues.zh: 我是不是太多疑了，呐呐呐
cues.en: Am I just paranoid, na na na

cues.zh: 呐呐，呐呐，呐呐
cues.en: na na, na na, na na

cues.zh: 我想推搡你，我会的，我会的；我想推倒你，我会的（Matchbox 20的《Push》[不是Saphire]）
cues.en: I wanna push you around, I will, I will I wanna push you down, I will ("Push" by Matchbox 20 [not Saphire])

cues.zh: 哇哦，和你一起生活真好（Better Than Ezra的《Good》）
cues.en: Whoa-ho, it's been good living with you ("Good" by Better Than Ezra)

cues.zh: 在我的Machine Head里，比其他的都好；我的Machine Head，比那……（Bush的《Machine Head》）
cues.en: In my machine head, is better than the rest My machine head, is better than the ("Machine Head" by Bush)

cues.zh: 看她眼中凝固的石头，看那荆棘在她身上缠绕（U2的《With or Without You》）
cues.en: See the stone set in her eye, See the thorn twist in her ("With or Without You" by U2)

cues.zh: 我的信念已耗尽，这就是我的感受，我又冷又羞愧，赤裸躺在地板上……（Natalie Imbru……管他谁唱的《Torn》）
cues.en: I'm all out of faith, this is how I feel, I am cold and I'm shamed, lying naked on the floor... ("Torn" by Natalie Imbru... whatever)

cues.zh: 他是个男孩，她是个女孩，还能再明显点吗？（Avril Lavigne的《Sk8r Boi》）
cues.en: He was a boy, she was a girl, Could it be anymore obvious? ("Sk8r Boi" by Avril Lavigne)

cues.zh: 我们不会屈服，不，我们绝不屈服！（Twisted Sister的《We're Not Gonna Take It》）
cues.en: We're not gonna take it, No, we ain't gonna take it! ("We're Not Gonna Take It" by Twisted Sister)

cues.zh: 预备，就位，出发，我们有了梦想，现在知道了（出自《拉文与雪莉》主题曲，那是1970年代很火的情景喜剧）
cues.en: On your mark, get set and go now Got a dream and we just know now (Theme from Laverne and Shirley, which was a popular sit-com in the 1970s)

cues.zh: 女人别哭，哭——咦——咦——咦（鲍勃·马利的《No Woman, No Cry》）
cues.en: No woman, cry-ee-i-ee-i ("No Woman, No Cry" by Bob Marley)

cues.zh: 每当我陷入困境，帕赫贝尔总跟随着我（套用披头士《Let It Be》的旋律）
cues.en: When I find myself in times of trouble Pachelbel's always follwing me (to the tune of "Let It Be" by the Beatles)

cues.zh: 帕赫贝尔，咱们地狱见！
cues.en: I'll see you in hell, Pachelbel!

cues.zh: 哦帕赫贝尔，帕赫贝尔，我让你在地狱里好看！
cues.en: Oh Pachelbel, Pachelbel, I'll see your a** in hell!

cues.zh: 帕赫贝尔，咱们地狱见！
cues.en: I'll see you in hell, Pachelbel!

cues.zh: 非常感谢，宾州州立大学！[观众欢呼]
cues.en: Thank you so much, Penn State! [crowd cheering]

cues.zh: 请享受接下来的演出！谢谢！
cues.en: Enjoy the rest of the show! Thanks!
